evidence_items.explanation: The review documents unreliable answers and failed requests from one contemporary assistant. One company's product cannot establish the claim about every company.

The March retest found substantial inaccuracies across five providers on election questions, but predates the target window and tests model APIs rather than representative assistant use. The report also records Meta's objection that its consumer assistant redirected those prompts to authoritative information.

unresolved_gaps: No sufficiently broad April 2024 comparison of deployed general-purpose assistants was established.
The available tests do not establish that every company's technology fell below an ordinary reliability standard.
Marcus supplies neither a reliability threshold nor a representative question distribution.
Model API errors do not necessarily describe the behavior of a deployed assistant with retrieval, safeguards or redirection.
